name: Except Those Lost Forever
source:
Gabriel wakes up in the In-Between with all his memories gone. He's told that he will have to make a choice, but first he needs to retrieve his missing memories. But who's that ghostly wolf that keeps appearing?

Explore the mazes of Gabriel's mind to find his memories and put them back together to solve the mystery of Gabriel's life and make the most important choice of his life.

[From [url=https://fdrstar.itch.io/except-those-lost-forever]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加百列在中间醒来，所有记忆都消失了。他被告知他必须做出选择，但首先他需要找回丢失的记忆。但那只不断出现的幽灵狼是谁？

探索加百列心灵的迷宫，找到他的记忆，并将它们重新组合起来，解开加百列的一生之谜，并做出他一生中最重要的选择。

[来自[url=https://fdrstar.itch.io/except-those-lost-forever]Itch.io[/url]]
